source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The full-width/full-height separator color divides the input into tiles.
    separator = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in grid for x in row))

            row_ranges.append((start, r))
        start = r + 1

    start = 0
    for c in sep_cols + [w]:
        if start < c:
            col_ranges.append((start, c))
        start = c + 1
    background = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in grid for x in row))
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in row_ranges:
        row_out = []
        for c0, c1 in col_ranges:
            count = sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))

'''

source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    solid_rows = [(r, row[0]) for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == row[0] for v in row)]
    separator = max(set(color for _, color in solid_rows), key=lambda color: sum(c == color for _, c in solid_rows))
    sep_rows = [r for r, color in solid_rows if color == separator]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == separator for r in range(h))]
    row_ranges, start = [], 0
    for r in sep_rows + [h]:
        if start < r:
            row_ranges.append((start, r))
        start = r + 1
    col_ranges, start = [], 0
    for c in sep_cols + [w]:
        if start < c:
            col_ranges.append((start, c))
        start = c + 1
    background = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in grid for x in row))
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in row_ranges:
        row_out = []
        for c0, c1 in col_ranges:
            count = sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            row_out.append(1 if count >= 2 else background)
        out.append(row_out)
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog', program_path); mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
